target.input: Same existing G10 MIX01 star received P0 and its frozen DURA P1; no new clean route or channel realization
target.historical_exposure: Exposed development RX/devices and Q; not a new blind confirmation

adaptation.kind: U-only binary knownness weighted graph harmonic fitting; all original identity features/logits fixed
adaptation.positive_seed: original paired margin>=0 and original P1 MSP>=.95
adaptation.negative_seed: original paired margin<0 and original P1 MSP<=.5
adaptation.prior: tanh(original source-frozen paired conditional margin); no target fit of threshold, cutoff fixed0
adaptation.graph: unit fused160, FP64 fixed-order cosine, mutual10NN excluding self; opaque-ID stable ties; d2=max(0,2-2*clip(cos,-1,1))
adaptation.sigma: sqrt(d2 to kth neighbor), floor1e-6, U-only for fitting; each Q row independently uses its own kth U-neighbor distance
adaptation.weights: exp(-d2/(sigma_i*sigma_j)) on mutual edges, no diagonal; D=row sums, L=D-W
adaptation.solution: one FP64 solve (I+L+10*diag(seed))*f=tanh(m)+10*seed_sign; no neural optimizer
adaptation.inference: for each Q independently k10 U neighbors: (tanh(mQ)+sum(w*fU))/(1+sum(w)); w same self-tuned formula
adaptation.empty_seed: If either positive or negative seeds absent, SKIPPED and DA1 exactly DA0 on both U and futureQ; no retune/retry
adaptation.identity: Original F0 P1 default six-class argmax is unchanged for all states
adaptation.deployment: Persist unlabeled U memory unit384x160 FP32, IDs, sigma384 and f384 FP64, plus graph schema/skipped flag; source per-record bank0

registration.state_per_DA: Independent U-only original DA0 and binary-adapted DA1; same frozen unit160 graph, autonomous K or0
registration.candidate: original and current old margins both strictly negative
registration.partition: connected components of candidate-induced current unit-fused mutual10NN graph, ordered by smallest opaque ID
registration.boundary: fraction of component records connected by reciprocal edge to any original trusted seed
registration.stability: opaque-ID alternating halves center separation<=component LOO Euclidean95% radius
registration.prototype: Same original unit160 component mean/radius; registration needs aggregate centers/radii but DA1 binary inference explicitly retains U memory
registration.decision: Old six margin>=0 takes precedence; otherwise allow nearest anonymous prototype only if inside its radius, else reject
registration.old_class_retention: REG cannot change an accepted old label or turn an old-rejected record into any old label
registration.mapping: two independent DA anonymous maps fixed by scorer on U truth before Q truth; never algorithm inputs

evaluation.freeze_order: Source F0/G/prior first; U graph/registries freeze before Q; all four state predictions before either private truth
evaluation.targets: configs/pamf_phase3_targets_20261029.json v3; overall and six main scenes CK90/RU90/originalF0loss2pp, positive old-AK adaptation; futureAN80 and REG oldloss2pp; missing required-class coverage N/A
evaluation.baseline: Same-input originalF0 P1; DA0 paired prior fixed, not new candidate closed as protection baseline
evaluation.A_N_denominator: all real U arrival classes on futureQ, undiscovered classes count0; no successful-cluster-only denominator

stop: Preserve on direct protocol/nonfinite/collision/unable-prediction errors; missing seed/K0/scientific failure is a valid result, never retune or retry
